description: Read what happened to the events sent to the agent (mba_send_agent_event) over a date range, one row per event type, busiest first: how many were received, how many the agent successfully processed, and the mean end-to-end latency. Successfully processed means the agent sent its message, not that the message was delivered. Figures are rolled up once a day, so the most recent day may still be incomplete. Known limitation: the dates are in PACIFIC TIME, not the business time zone, and the range may span at most 30 days, counting both ends.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

end_date.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific Time. Inclusive.

event_type.description: Return only this event type, named as it was sent. Omit for every event type.

start_date.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific Time. Inclusive.

name: mba_get_agent_event_insights
title: Read agent event insights
